desc: Give yourself the advantage of unbelievably quick follow up shots when you choose the world's fastest pump action shotgun, the Winchester SXP. The silky smooth pump action is inertia assisted and seems almost effortless. The SXP Shadow Defender is an ideal choice for home defense. Loaded out with features like an 18" chrome lined barrel with fixed cylinder bore, pistol grip, interchangeable comb pieces, spacers to adjust length of pull, and side mounted Picatinny rails for addition of optional accessories, the SXP Shadow Defender is the definition of tactical home defense shotgun.
